name: Mudrock Soup and Bugs
summary: In Theramore, Morgan Stern is working on a dish called Mudrock Soup and Bugs, which could be the next big thing at the inns of Stormwind City. Morgan Stern doubts they would survive a long trek through Dustwallow Marsh, and so asks you to gather tongues from the Mudrock turtles.

sections.title: A Dish in the Making
sections.body: Morgan Stern is working on a dish called Mudrock Soup and Bugs, and still needs the major ingredients. A long trek through Dustwallow Marsh is more than Morgan Stern expects to survive, so you are asked to do some hunting. First come the tongues of Mudrock turtles.

sections.title: Forked Tongues
sections.body: Mudrocks roam the coast, mostly around the bay. Morgan Stern wants no ordinary tongues. Word has reached Morgan Stern that some Mudrocks have forked tongues, and that these carry a distinct flavor wanted in the dish.

sections.title: Toward the Table
sections.body: Morgan Stern will try different ways of cooking the tongues, searching for what best brings out their taste. The hope is a dish fit to be served at the Blue Recluse in Stormwind.

faq.q: Who is asking for the turtle tongues?
aliases: who starts mudrock soup and bugs
faq.answer: Morgan Stern, in Theramore, who is working on a dish called Mudrock Soup and Bugs.

faq.q: Where can the Mudrock turtles be found?
faq.answer: Along the coast of Dustwallow Marsh, mostly around the bay.

faq.q: Why does Morgan Stern want forked tongues specifically?
faq.answer: Morgan Stern has heard they carry a distinct flavor, and wants that flavor in the dish.

faq.q: Why won't Morgan Stern gather the ingredients in person?
faq.answer: Morgan Stern does not think they would survive a long trek through Dustwallow Marsh.
The next step is called ... and Bugs.
